answer: `_CTX.sourcePage` gives the page the expression's text comes from (`{ name = … }`). Inside a transclusion it is the transcluded page, whereas `_CTX.currentPage` is the currently open page.

--- Space Lua/Thread Locals.md ---
Thread Locals
There is “magic” `_CTX` global variable available from which you can access some context-specific values. Currently the following keys are available:

* `_CTX.currentPage` providing access to the currently open page (PageMeta object)
* `_CTX.sourcePage` the page the expression’s text comes from (`{ name = … }`): the transcluded page inside a transclusion, otherwise the current page

--- API/widget.md ---
What a plain `${...}` renders | Widget types > Markdown widgets > Showing text without evaluating it
Markdown widgets evaluate what they render: `${...}` expressions run, and `![[Page]]` pulls in other pages. When a widget shows text written by someone else (an imported note, a form entry, generated text), pass `evaluate = false`. The text is still rendered as Markdown (formatting, lists, links), but expressions and transclusions stay literal text:

```lua
widget.markdownBlock(importedText, { evaluate = false })
widget.new { markdown = importedText, evaluate = false }
```

For text placed inside HTML, escape it with `string.escapeHtml` instead.

--- Transclusions.md ---
Media | Pages
Syntax:
* `![[page name]]` embed an entire page
* `![[page name#header]]` embed only a section (guarded by the given header)

Text and source documents are not transcluded as highlighted source. The editable text-document fallback does not change this boundary: page transclusion remains limited to Markdown pages.

--- Guide/Knowledge Base.md ---
Create topic pages | Reuse content across pages
Insert a [[Transclusions|transclusion]] with `![[Page name]]` to display another page’s content without maintaining a separate copy. This also works for an overview containing a query.

Live queries render in SilverBullet. [[Baked Sections]] explains how to store computed output when you need portable Markdown.

--- Live Preview.md ---
Revealing the source | Widget rendering
[[Space Lua#Expressions]] (`${...}`) are rendered inline in place. The underlying code follows the source-reveal rules above. Queries, templates and widgets display their results within the document. An expression re-runs when something it read changes. See [[API/widget#When expressions update]]. Use the ⋯ menu on a block widget to reload, copy or bake it.
